instruction: Hold the blue jacket steady and start its zipper. Grasp the reinforced blue tape behind the loose silver insertion pin at the hem. Align the pin with the opening beside the orange slider and insert it fully into the retaining box. Then grasp the orange pull and zip the jacket all the way to the collar. Regrasp if needed, and release the jacket and zipper when finished.
note: Recorded evaluation reports the scalar score; its serialization omitted custom scorer state metadata.
